notes.title: Game-Update / Devlog #4
notes.content:
[p]Hi all,[/p][p]Slight disappointment! My goal of having a reasonably oke demo for the steam-next fest in october is not going to happen. Only three days before the sign-up day for the festival is over. Too much work for too little time. 

I had good hopes that during the holidays my extra time available would be sufficient, unfortunately it wasn't! Had some friends played the latest version and there was still. again, too much to do.[/p][p]
That said, still happy with the progress made but it just isn't enough. [/p][p]-fixed tutorial map for 90% give or take. But you know, 10% is 90% of the work.[/p][p]-added a sprint feature, small extra but needed to give a bit more sense of urgency[/p][p]-changed HUD[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon,[/p][p]Antihero[/p]
